rules.statement: The Court of Requests has jurisdiction to hear a case where the value of the property in dispute exceeds its monetary limits if the claim is for recovery of possession and not for the value of the land itself.
rules.supporting_quote: It seems to me that in examining the question whether the present action is within the monetary jurisdiction of the Court of Requests the words of section 327 which direct the court to �investigate the claim� of the defendant must be given their due weight.
